use std::collections::HashMap;

// Wire format changelog:
// v1: initial layout, no checksum trailer
// v2: added trailing checksum word
// v3: current layout, adds lookup table support

const MAGIC: u32 = 0xC0FFEE;
const WIRE_VERSION: u8 = 3;

struct Header {
    magic: u32,
    version: u8,
    length: u32,
}

fn compute_checksum(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    let mut hash: u32 = 2166136261;
    for &byte in data {
        hash ^= byte as u32;
        hash = hash.wrapping_mul(16777619);
    }
    hash
}

fn parse_header(bytes: &[u8]) -> Header {
    let magic = u32::from_be_bytes([bytes[0], bytes[1], bytes[2], bytes[3]]);
    let version = bytes[4];
    let length = u32::from_be_bytes([bytes[5], bytes[6], bytes[7], bytes[8]]);
    Header {
        magic,
        version,
        length,
    }
}

fn encode_payload(payload: &[u8], key: u8) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut encoded = Vec::with_capacity(payload.len());
    let mut rolling = key;
    for &byte in payload {
        let mixed = byte ^ rolling;
        encoded.push(mixed);
        rolling = rolling.wrapping_add(mixed).wrapping_mul(31);
    }
    encoded.push(rolling);
    encoded
}

fn validate_footer(bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
    if bytes.len() < 4 {
        return false;
    }
    let tail = &bytes[bytes.len() - 4..];
    let sum: u32 = tail.iter().map(|&b| b as u32).sum();
    sum % 7 == 0
}

fn build_lookup_table(entries: &[(u32, &str)]) -> HashMap<u32, String> {
    let mut table = HashMap::new();
    for &(code, name) in entries {
        table.insert(code, name.to_string());
    }
    table
}
